title: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Temporal Reasoning Aggregation
authors_zh: Jiakun Li、Xingwei He、Kefan Li、Hongzheng Chai、Hongyue Yu、Yuan Yuan（机构：北京航空航天大学）
paper_type_zh: 无需训练的时间早停研究
best_for_zh: 部署长推理轨迹安全自适应停止的读者。
one_line: TRACE halts reasoning when answer consistency and confidence remain stable across recent reasoning steps.
TRACE 在答案一致性和置信度跨近期推理步骤保持稳定时停止推理。
why: It treats convergence as a temporal property and directly reduces token waste from overthinking.
inclusion_reason: It makes online early-exit depend on temporal stability across reasoning steps rather than one instantaneous confidence value.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning models often continue generating after they have effectively reached a stable answer. A fixed length budget wastes tokens on easy cases, but single-step confidence early exit is unsafe because a model can be transiently confident in an incorrect intermediate answer.

The paper asks how an online stopping rule can distinguish genuine convergence from a short-lived confidence spike. It treats the decision as temporal: the system should examine whether answers persist and whether confidence remains coherent across several recent reasoning steps before it releases the remaining compute budget.

推理模型常在实际上已经得到稳定答案后继续生成。固定长度预算会在简单案例上浪费令牌，但单步置信度早停并不安全，因为模型可能暂时对错误的中间答案充满信心。

论文研究在线停止规则如何区分真正的收敛与短暂的置信度峰值。它将决定视为时间性的：系统应检查答案是否持续出现，以及置信度是否在多个近期推理步骤中保持一致，然后才释放剩余计算预算。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TRACE defines convergence from a sliding window of reasoning steps instead of from one token-level estimate. Answer Consistency Score measures whether an induced candidate answer recurs across the window, while Confidence Trajectory Score summarizes the model's confidence for that answer over the same time span.

The two signals are combined into a stability score. Only when the best candidate exceeds a threshold does the system stop and return it; otherwise the reasoning model continues. This converts early exit from a reactive confidence heuristic into a test-time allocation rule based on sustained evidence.

TRACE 从一个推理步骤滑动窗口定义收敛，而不是从单个令牌级估计定义。答案一致性分数衡量诱导出的候选答案是否在窗口中反复出现；置信度轨迹分数则汇总模型在同一时间跨度内对该答案的置信度。

两个信号被合成为稳定性分数。只有最优候选超过阈值时，系统才停止并返回它；否则推理模型继续生成。这把早停从反应式置信度启发式方法变成基于持续证据的测试时分配规则。

title: Method
方法
html:
TRACE segments a running chain of thought into reasoning steps and induces a candidate final answer at each step. It stores recent induced answers and confidence values, computes answer consistency and temporal confidence within a sliding window, then evaluates their weighted stability score.

If the score crosses the configured threshold, generation terminates with that induced answer; otherwise another reasoning step is produced. The mechanism needs no fine-tuning of the underlying model, but it does add answer induction and window bookkeeping, so token savings must be measured together with that overhead.

TRACE 将运行中的思维链切分为推理步骤，并在每一步诱导一个候选最终答案。它存储近期诱导答案和置信度数值，在滑动窗口中计算答案一致性与时间置信度，然后评估其加权稳定性分数。

若分数越过设定阈值，生成便以该诱导答案终止；否则再生成一个推理步骤。该机制不需要微调底层模型，但会增加答案诱导和窗口管理，因此令牌节省必须与这些开销一起测量。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates TRACE on OlympiadBench, MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, and AIME25 across Qwen3, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and R1-distilled models. It compares against full-length reasoning and dynamic early-exit baselines, reporting accuracy and token compression rather than only one metric.

The authors report 25–30% average token reduction while retaining accuracy within 1–2% of full-length reasoning, and report 2–4 average accuracy points over strong early-exit baselines at comparable or lower budgets. These gains depend on answer induction, window size, threshold choice, and model confidence access; the official code should be used to reproduce the full trade-off.

论文在 OlympiadBench、MATH500、AIME24、AMC23 和 AIME25 上评估 TRACE，涉及 Qwen3、Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 R1 蒸馏模型。它与完整长度推理和动态早停基线比较，同时报告准确率和令牌压缩，而不是只报告一个指标。

作者报告平均减少 25% 至 30% 的令牌，同时准确率保持在完整长度推理的 1% 至 2% 以内；在相当或更低预算下，相比强早停基线平均提高 2 至 4 个准确率点。这些增益依赖答案诱导、窗口大小、阈值选择和模型置信度访问；应使用官方代码复现完整权衡。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior early-exit methods commonly ask whether the model is confident at the current step. TRACE asks whether an answer and its confidence have remained stable over a recent temporal interval. It therefore explicitly addresses transient overconfidence, a failure case where one high-confidence intermediate prediction would prematurely stop reasoning.

The contribution is a training-free convergence criterion combining answer persistence and confidence evolution, together with online step segmentation and answer induction. This makes the new unit of allocation a stable window of reasoning behavior, rather than a fixed token count or a single local confidence value.

既有早停方法通常询问模型在当前步骤是否自信。TRACE 询问一个答案及其置信度是否在最近的一段时间内保持稳定。因此，它明确处理短暂过度自信这一失败情形：一次高置信度中间预测会过早停止推理。

贡献是一项无需训练的收敛准则，结合答案持续性和置信度演化，并配套在线步骤切分与答案诱导。这使新的分配单位成为稳定的推理行为窗口，而不是固定令牌数或单一局部置信度值。

title: Limitations
局限
html: TRACE can still misidentify convergence when induced answers are parsed incorrectly, when a model repeats a wrong answer consistently, or when confidence is poorly calibrated. Sliding windows and auxiliary answer induction add overhead and introduce threshold sensitivity. It should be tested on tasks where correct solutions genuinely require late revisions, because aggressive stopping may hide these cases.
当诱导答案被错误解析、模型持续重复错误答案或置信度校准较差时，TRACE 仍可能误判收敛。滑动窗口和辅助答案诱导会增加开销，并引入阈值敏感性。应在正确解答确实需要后期修订的任务上测试它，因为过于激进的停止可能掩盖这些案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use TRACE when serving long reasoning traces from a model whose intermediate answers and token probabilities are accessible. Log reasoning steps, induced answers, both component scores, exit threshold, saved tokens, induction overhead, and correctness. Compare against full reasoning and single-step early exit at matched accuracy targets, not only at a common threshold.
当服务可访问长推理轨迹模型的中间答案和令牌概率时，可以使用 TRACE。应记录推理步骤、诱导答案、两个组成分数、退出阈值、节省令牌、诱导开销和正确性。应在匹配准确率目标下与完整推理和单步早停比较，而不只在共同阈值下比较。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the answer-induction mechanism together with the stopping rule: stable induced answers are useful only if they faithfully summarize the current reasoning prefix. Inspect cases of false convergence and late correction separately. The main audit question is whether TRACE saves computation after the answer is genuinely stable, rather than merely cutting off hard trajectories.
应把答案诱导机制与停止规则一起阅读：稳定的诱导答案只有在忠实概括当前推理前缀时才有价值。应分别检查错误收敛和后期纠正案例。核心审计问题是 TRACE 是否在答案真正稳定后节省计算，而不是仅仅截断困难轨迹。
